recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the residual source-field part of FHIR-37594 without changing cardinality, datatypes, examples, or unrelated Financial Management content.
issue_request: FHIR-37594 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested correction of the cut-and-paste Claim.item.net definition, including the Net = unit price * quantity * factor wording, the requirement that the line-item amount is needed to know what is being charged, and application of the same change to all .net elements in Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit.
initial_application: Commit 1521c32f7a applied the approved net definition wording to the three Claim .net elements, three ClaimResponse.addItem .net elements, and six ExplanationOfBenefit item/addItem .net elements. Commit 569461dff5 later touched the same StructureDefinitions while adding traceNumber content for FHIR-32797, but the .net requirements fields still retained the older duplicated claimed-amount wording.
additional_context: The affected Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit StructureDefinitions are current build-scope sources through active source/fhir.ini resource entries. Searches found FHIR-37594 as the only FHIR-core issue for the exact net-definition phrase, with other Jira hits limited to IG profile/cardinality issues; Zulip and Confluence searches found no core discussion or later decision that reverses the FHIR-37594 requirement wording.
reconciliation: Updated the requirements text on every current Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit .net element to the Jira-approved rationale. Definitions were already correct and were left unchanged.
